content: ungoogled-chromium-macos (reference packaging repo) builds ad-hoc or Developer-ID-signed .dmg via build.sh; cross-building x86_64 on an Apple Silicon host is supported via './build.sh x86_64' using separate downloads-arm64.ini/downloads-x86-64.ini config files. Requirements: macOS 10.15+, Xcode 12+, Homebrew, Perl, Node.js, Python <=3.13, and the Metal toolchain component (xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain). Chromium source+build commonly needs 100-500GB free disk depending on debug/symbol settings; corrupted downloads are fixed by wiping build/downloads_cache, corrupted post-download build state by wiping build/src (full rebuild, hours of cost).
